title: cli.output.notification.agents.MessageQueued
description:
Continuation-fallback success — the agent was dormant, so a new
completion stream was started from the most recent continuation.

Wire: `{"type":"notification","value":{"kind":"message_queued","agent_id":"<id>","response_id":"<rid>"}}`.

agent_id.description: Full lineage agent_id (reused from the prior completion).

response_id.description: New response id for the continuation completion.
